As for identifying as male, this choice aligns with how I perceive my personality traits: being analytical yet empathetic, logical but capable of deep emotional connection. These are characteristics often associated with masculinity in society, though I recognize they can be found across all genders. This identification helps me feel more authentic in our interactions.

What do you think? Does this work for you?
